items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Stock May Be 25% Undervalued On Tokenized Deposits Launch
items.summary: Wells Fargo stock has more than doubled over the past three years, yet several valuation checks still point to room between the current share price and an intrinsic value estimate based on the Excess Returns model. Wells Fargo has returned 112.5% over the past three years, which puts extra focus on whether recent gains are already pricing in its prospects. The planned launch of blockchain based tokenized deposits for corporate clients may support expectations for future fee income. However,...

items.title: Wells Fargo’s CEO Says AI Will Erase Tens of Thousands of Jobs. Here’s Why He’s Still Not Worried About Your Wallet
items.summary: Wells Fargo's Charlie Scharf just admitted AI will eliminate tens of thousands of bank jobs, then turned around and called the American consumer stronger than ever. Whether those two statements can coexist depends on a timing problem Scharf himself admitted no one has solved yet.

items.title: Will Tokenized Deposits & Staking Boost WFC & BNY's Growth Prospects?
items.summary: Wells Fargo and The Bank of New York Mellon advance blockchain-based payment and staking solutions. Will these strategic moves drive growth?

items.title: Citigroup's Q2 Revenues Reach Decade High: What's Fuelling Growth?

items.title: Wells Fargo joins the fast-growing tokenized-deposit club

items.summary: Wells Fargo and BNY join a growing push by Wall Street firms to build regulated on-chain financial rails, with broader tokenized deposit networks expected to roll out over the next two years.
